workflow: A child view retains a non-owning pointer into storage owned by a parent object.
The parent object is explicitly destroyed while the child view remains reachable.
A later representation or inspection operation on the child view dereferences the retained pointer without checking whether the parent storage still exists.
The access uses freed storage, causing a use-after-free failure instead of reporting that the view is invalid.
summary: Retained child view outlives destroyed parent storage
